title: Chapter 1438
text:
Now that the halos were not around, it was not a good time to complete the mission. Han Xiao closed the interface and turned to look at Oathkeeper and Clottey.

"Do you guys have nothing to do? Is the war over? Has the enemy been defeated? "

"No …" Oathkeeper and Clottey came back to their senses. They suppressed their fear of Han Xiao and shook their heads.

"Then what are you guys waiting for? Go and deal with the enemy."

"I'll go now."

Without another word, Oathkeeper stepped into the spatial rift and found a shallow dimensional battlefield to join.

Clottey took a deep look at Han Xiao before disappearing.

The battle between the two Transcendent Grade Supers in the spatial storm was not monitored by the three Universal Civilizations, but he remembered it all. Be it Black Star's terrifying combat strength or the World Tree's Transcendent trump card, this important information had to be reported to the upper echelons.

Han Xiao did not retract his troops. He only shrunk the size of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate and tore open a spatial rift that led to a battlefield. Then, he controlled the Mechanical Deity to walk in.

The battleships in the sky were shooting at each other. The battle was very intense, and the three Universal Civilizations' troops were in a critical situation. Less than thirty percent of them were left, and they were being surrounded and annihilated.

When the Blessed Race of the World Tree saw a Mechanical Deity with black clouds all over its body descend, they immediately changed the direction of their attacks and rained down cannon fire.

The Supreme Heavenly Venerate did not move. The mechanical soldiers that had condensed into black clouds around him immediately split up and blocked in front of him. At the same time, they activated their shields, and their energy connected together, forming a huge psionic shield that protected the entire Supreme Heavenly Venerate. All the fleet's cannon fire was blocked, and the surface of the shield was covered in light and ripples.

Han Xiao raised the Emperor Skysplitter Blade and pointed it at the large World Tree fleet that filled the sky. He twisted his arm slightly, causing the blade to spin half a circle. The next moment, an invisible psionic wave spread out from the tip of the sword and quickly swept out, enveloping more than half of the fleet.

The next moment, countless battleships flashed with electric sparks at the same time, and their shields shattered and disappeared. All of them malfunctioned and fell in different directions as if they had lost power.

Wherever the psionic waves passed, battleships fell like rain!

Now that Han Xiao was dealing with a large number of troops, there was no longer a need for him to use the human wave tactic. Psionic waves were a great killing weapon in group battles, and they were finally being used on an official battlefield today. In the face of this technology, the number of fleets was almost meaningless.

"This black technology is even more useful than I expected. It was worth it for me to strengthen you into a divine artifact."

Han Xiao couldn't help but feel elated as he looked at the spectacular scene of the spaceships falling from the sky.

This time, he had revealed his strength in order to seal the Secret Tree King. Now that there was no need to continue hiding, he naturally chose to participate in the battle.

"Hegemon, there are too many battlefields. You can't do anything by yourself. Should we join in?"

Psionic Prime stood on the shoulder of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate with his Mechanical Oracles and asked respectfully.

"Bring the boys to help." Han Xiao nodded.

As soon as he said that, the dozens of Mechanical Oracles immediately took action. They each brought a batch of mechanical troops and headed to different shallow dimensional battlefields to support the three Universal Civilizations and suppress the invading World Tree Blessed Race.

With the enhancement of Han Xiao's Mechanical Force, the combat strength of the mechanical army was extraordinary, and it increased by leaps and bounds. The mechanical army entered the battlefield one after another, immediately giving the various World Tree Blessed Race a head-on blow.

Han Xiao controlled the Supreme Heavenly Venerate to move alone. The enormous mechanical life form that could pierce through the heavens and earth strolled through the dimensional battlefields one after another. He casually waved the Emperor Skysplitter Blade, a huge double-headed broadsword, and kept activating AOE attacks. Psionic waves slashed out like blades of light, sweeping across the World Tree fleet.

After fighting for an unknown period of time, Han Xiao could not remember how many World Tree Blessed Race members he had destroyed. Suddenly, in the remaining shallow dimensional battlefields, the World Tree fleet stopped firing at the same time and retreated like the tide.

They had wanted to end the battle quickly, but they had kicked an iron plate. Seeing that things were not going to work, the World Tree Blessed Race finally gave up on the invasion and chose to retreat.

"We've finally repelled the World Tree's attack."

In the conference room of the leaders of the main universe, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations looked at the scene of the World Tree army retreating and finally relaxed their tense minds.

"It wasn't easy for the World Tree to find an opportunity to open a second front. They won't give up so easily. After resting for a while, they might make a comeback," Louis pondered.

The Ethereal Pope nodded and said with a worried tone, "The opening of the second front is very disadvantageous for us. The secondary dimension battlefield is a meat grinder that is even more terrifying than the main universe border. It's mainly a head-on clash, and the losses will not be low. Their fleet is endless, but our losses are real. Although the Underworld can contain most of the hero spirits of the dead, Aurora's Energy Level can't bear the losses of the soldiers on the galactic battlefield … "

Marbruce clasped his hands and suddenly said, "It's not a big problem. The enemy has an army, and we have Black Star."

Hearing this, the other two had complicated expressions.

They had only known the true strength of a Transcendent after receiving Clottey's report. They had already tried their best to raise their expectations, but they did not expect to still underestimate Han Xiao's strength.

"Sigh, the strength of a Transcendent is really shocking. However, I didn't expect the World Tree to also have a Transcendent," the Ethereal Pope said in surprise.

"Fortunately, Black Star has stepped into the Transcendent Grade. Otherwise, I'm afraid no one on our side would be able to counter the World Tree's trump card. We would definitely suffer heavy casualties …"

The three of them had complicated feelings and some lingering fear.

The Transcendent Grade Black Star made them extremely afraid, but it also gave them a sense of security. If Black Star had not broken through this limit, the galactic society would have been at an absolute disadvantage in terms of individual strength. Once the Tree God descended, they would definitely have been destroyed and would not have been able to counterattack.

The current battle situation was barely stable, and at least half of it was due to Black Star's contribution. His contribution was greater than the three of them combined.

"However, after this battle, the World Tree should have been frightened by Black Star. The next time it attacks the shallow dimension, it will most likely think twice before making any plans."

The three of them nodded and heaved a sigh of relief.

…

World Tree Territory, Tree King Palace.

Specks of green light gathered on the throne and condensed into the bodies of the Ancestral Tree King and the Fortitude Tree King. Both of them had ugly expressions, not only because the Secret Tree King was sealed, but also because of the aftereffects of removing the Tree God's Descent.

"The Secret Tree King is gone too … I didn't expect that Mechanic, who was still a peak Beyond Grade A more than ten years ago, to have actually stepped into the Transcendent Grade."

The Ancestral Tree King rubbed his forehead to ease the tearing pain in his soul. He spoke hoarsely with a rare tone of shock and anger.

When Black Star revealed his true strength and instantly killed the Secret Tree King, he was shocked. He knew that the Secret Tree King was most likely dead, so he decisively gave up on the Secret Tree King and activated the Tree God's Descent without hesitation.

The Tree God's Descent was like mixing the bodies and souls of the five Tree Kings together. It was extremely painful, forming a new subconsciousness that fused with the will of the mother tree. The aftereffects were very serious. After disintegrating, the Tree King would have problems recognizing his identity from time to time. His thoughts would be in chaos for a long time before he could slowly recover.

If not for the fact that he had no other choice, the Ancestral Tree King would not have used it. It was not that he wanted to compete with Black Star, but he was worried that if he did not summon the Tree God, he would not be able to escape from Black Star's hands and follow in the footsteps of the Secret Tree King.

In addition, every time the Tree God's Descent was used, it would severely overdraft the Tree King Crown, causing the power of the Tree King to decrease. It would take time to recover, and before the Tree King Crown completely returned to its peak, it would be the usual cooldown period of the Tree God's Descent. If the Tree God's Descent was used continuously, after three times, the Tree King Crown would shatter and disappear. It would take thousands of years for it to be regenerated, which meant that during this period, the Tree King would no longer have any special bonuses and would only be a pure title.

Furthermore, the Tree God's Descent also required a special fuel. It was a material called the 'King's Relic'. When a Tree King failed to advance to the Transcendent Grade and died, this special material would be produced. The mother tree could not convert it and could only store it. Although it had accumulated over the years, there were fewer and fewer Tree Kings who chose to advance. Every time the 'King's Relic' was used, there would be one less … And only the Ancestral Tree King knew about this!

As the oldest Tree King, the Ancestral Tree King also knew another secret. Currently, if any member of the World Tree chose to advance to the Transcendent Grade, they would definitely die. This had nothing to do with talent but the restrictions of the mother tree.

In the beginning, the mother tree was not as strong as it was now. It had only grown to its current state after devouring countless things through the feedback of the civilization.

Only by devouring a new thing and possessing the Information Form of this thing would the World Tree be able to unlock the corresponding ability … And the World Tree had never devoured a Transcendent Grade life form, so Beyond Grade A was the limit of the World Tree Supers.

However, this did not mean that the members of the World Tree could not advance. In fact, as long as a Tree King stepped into the Transcendent Grade, they would be able to take back the Information Form that was devoured by the mother tree and break free from the World Tree, becoming completely free.

However, the World Tree did not allow any member to escape its control. As long as someone tried to advance, not only would the mother tree not protect them, it would also automatically interfere. This was because everyone's Information Form was under its control, and it could easily trigger a vicious mutation … Therefore, in terms of performance, they would never reach the Transcendent Grade. All the advanced Tree Kings died and turned into the 'King's Relic', which was the Beyonder's Vestige, and were stored in the World Tree.

Therefore, after the Tree God descended, the mother tree's will had a strong appetite and could not wait to eat Black Star … As long as it devoured this true Transcendent Grade life form, it would be able to obtain the Information Form of the Transcendent Grade and unlock the upper limit of its individual strength.

Infinite resurrection naturally came with a price. Their upper limit was stuck. Only when the World Tree grew would their upper limit be able to increase at the same time … However, other than the Ancestral Tree King, no one knew about this.

The Ancestral Tree King never chose to advance because he did not want to benefit others. Furthermore, he kept this secret and did not tell the subsequent Tree Kings.

All sorts of thoughts flashed through his mind as the Ancestral Tree King spoke with a deep voice.

"The timing of that Mechanic's advancement is too coincidental. Luck is not on our side. Fortunately, I took back the Tree King Crown of the Secret Tree King at the critical moment. Otherwise, the power of the Tree God would have declined further."

"The Secret Tree King is hopeless. Who are you going to let inherit this crown?"

The Fortitude Tree King held his head in pain and asked.

"… Let's observe again."

The Ancestral Tree King's expression was solemn as he scanned the three empty thrones. He was in an extremely bad mood.

Of the five Great Tree Kings, one was dead, and two were sealed. Only the two of them were left. When had they ever been in such a sorry state in the process of conquering the universe?

It was simply miserable, miserable, miserable, miserable …

Furthermore, the one who stayed behind to accompany him was the most annoying Fortitude Tree King. The Ancestral Tree King felt tired.

The one he wanted to get rid of the most was the Fortitude Tree King. It was not only because this guy liked to slack off, but also because he suspected that the Fortitude Tree King might have guessed something, which was why he was so lazy.

The Fortitude Tree King did not notice the Ancestral Tree King's gaze and said worriedly, "The Tree God's descent is not complete, and we are not a match for that Mechanic. We are completely suppressed in terms of individual strength. What should we do in the future?"

"We can only temporarily give up on the battle of individual strength. Don't let the high-level combatants take action anymore. Otherwise, all of them will be sealed. Furthermore, I'm afraid we won't be able to save the Heart Tree King. That Tree King Crown might be lost forever …"

The Ancestral Tree King was depressed.

The Fortitude Tree King said worriedly, "What about the mother tree's natural enemy?"

"… This is a ticking time bomb. I still have to think of a way."

The Ancestral Tree King's eyes darkened.

The World Tree was originally very calm about this war. It was not in a hurry and was fearless.

However, the appearance of the Pivotal Snake had hit their vitals, causing their great situation to become precarious. They had no choice but to race against time and drag them into the quagmire!

If it was just the coordinates of the mother tree's main body being exposed, the Ancestral Tree King would not have panicked. He had always emphasized that the main body could not be moved, but in fact, the main body of the mother tree was not fixed. Although the process of moving it was very troublesome, it could indeed be transplanted to other secondary dimensions.

The reason why he had revealed false information was to leave a way out and act as a trap … However, until today, no civilization had forced him to use this trump card, so the Ancestral Tree King had kept it a secret until now.

However, the adult Pivotal Snake could sense the location of the mother tree's main body at any time. It was equivalent to a positioning radar with infinite distance. No matter how hard he tried to transplant the main body, it would be useless. This was a huge matter regarding the survival of a civilization, so the Ancestral Tree King had to take it seriously!

However, even if the World Tree could sense its natural enemy, the Pivotal Snake was protected by that Mechanic. They had almost no chance. This was the greatest threat!

After thinking about it, he was still at a loss.

The only way he could think of to break out of this situation was to quickly destroy the three Universal Civilizations regardless of the casualties. This way, even if Black Star had the Pivotal Snake, it would be difficult for him to gather enough strength to attack the mother tree's main body.

"Even so, it's only a temporary solution. That Mechanic will forever be a threat to the mother tree.

If there are no variables, I'm afraid … "

The Ancestral Tree King clenched his fists. A layer of haze covered his heart, and his expression was uncertain.
